title: Anomaly Identification during Polymerase Chain Reaction for Detecting SARS-CoV-2 Using Artificial Intelligence Trained from Simulated Data
summary: ML models trained on simulated RT-PCR curves were applied to real SARS-CoV-2 laboratory data to flag atypical amplifications, a distinct field result with an enabling AI role and real-data evaluation.
ai_technology: Linear discriminant analysis (LDA) binary classifier trained on simulated RT-PCR curves
organization: MacondoLab, Universidad Simón Bolívar, Barranquilla 080002, Colombia; School of Basic and Biomedical Science, Universidad Simón Bolívar, Barranquilla 080002, Colombia

evidence.tested: ML models trained on simulated RT-PCR curves were applied to real SARS-CoV-2 laboratory data to flag atypical amplifications, a distinct field result with an enabling AI role and real-data evaluation.
evidence.unknown: Generalization beyond the reported cohort, dataset, or test setting was not established in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: LDA-based classifiers trained on simulated amplification curves flagged atypical SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR profiles in real laboratory data; the paper notes dependence on PCR-machine parameters.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
